description: This file defines and exports hook functions `beforeMount` and `afterMount` for managing callbacks that are to be executed before and after a component mounts, respectively. It also sets up global references on the `window` object to store these hook callback arrays.

methods.name: beforeMount
methods.description: Registers a callback to be called before the component mounts by pushing it into the __pw_hooks_before_mount array.

methods.name: afterMount
methods.description: Registers a callback to be called after the component mounts by pushing it into the __pw_hooks_after_mount array.
